info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Unit Trust Administration Management API
info.description: The Unit Trust Administration Management API facilitates the updating and maintenance of unit trust account details within the banking operations framework. This endpoint allows users to make modifications to existing unit trust records, ensuring that financial information remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include financial institutions, asset managers, and compliance officers who require reliable and efficient management of unit trust accounts. By streamlining administrative tasks, this API enhances operational efficiency and supports regulatory compliance.
